info.name: Workday Report Writer Workday Prism Analytics Buckets Query Execution API
Workday Report Writer Execute a WQL Query

params.name: query
params.description: WQL query string using SQL-like syntax. Example: SELECT workdayID, fullName FROM workers WHERE supervisoryOrganization = 'IT Department' ORDER BY fullName LIMIT 100

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: Execute a Workday Query Language (WQL) query and retrieve paginated results. Supports SQL-like syntax with SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, and LIMIT clauses. WQL also supports special operators such as startsWith, contains, and endsWith for text filtering.
